svg.title: Budding Yeast Model
svg.desc: Original vector budding yeast model with an oval mother cell, attached daughter bud, narrow bud neck, vacuole, nucleus, and editable semantic regions.
svg.metadata: {"source_asset": {"id": "core.model.yeast_budding", "name": "Budding Yeast Model", "category": "model-system", "tags": ["budding yeast", "yeast model", "fungal cell", "model organism", "saccharomyces", "microbial model"], "description": "Original vector budding yeast model with an oval mother cell, attached daughter bud, narrow bud neck, vacuole, nucleus, and editable semantic regions.", "file": "svg/budding_yeast_model.svg", "source_type": "original_vector_draft", "license": "CC0-1.0", "provenance": "Original Figure Studio vector asset drawn from generic budding-yeast morphology; no proprietary library artwork, organism-specific reference image, scraping, tracing, or protected asset recreation was used.", "style_family": "figure-studio-soft-line-v1", "review_status": "visual_reviewed_2026_07_20", "style_status": "soft_line_v1_model_organism_batch_1", "mvp_quality": "curated", "editable_region_count": 5, "reviewer_notes": "The oval mother cell, smaller attached bud, narrow neck, vacuole, and nucleus create a specific budding-yeast read without encoding species, strain, ploidy, cell-cycle timing, genotype, growth condition, or phenotype.", "editable_color_regions": [{"id": "cell_body", "label": "Mother-cell body", "default": "#F4E8C1", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "bud", "label": "Daughter bud", "default": "#F4A261", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "vacuole", "label": "Vacuole", "default": "#E8EEF7", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "nucleus", "label": "Nucleus", "default": "#7B78C9", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "outline", "label": "Cell, bud, neck, and vacuole outlines", "default": "#26323D", "paint": "stroke"}]}, "source_svg": "scientific-packs/core-biology/svg/budding_yeast_model.svg", "source_archive": "scientific-packs(1).zip", "output_style": "Style 4", "batch": "009", "source_metadata_is_unmodified": true, "source_review_status_applies_to_original_only": true}
